newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian defence minister flies to China.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister flies to China.

text.p: Russia's defence minister Igor Rodionov left on Sunday morning for an official visit to China, a spokesman said, in the latest sign of warming relations between the two nations.

During the visit, Rodionov will have talks with China's defence minister, hold a meeting at a local military academy, and visit military sites as well as cultural monuments, a defence ministry spokesman said.
He plans to return to Moscow on April 18.
The visit comes just prior to a scheduled visit of Chinese President Jiang Zemin to Moscow from April 22 to 26 aimed at building closer ties after decades of distrust.
Jiang's trip will step up Russian efforts to strengthen relations in the East as it faces difficulties in ties with the West over the NATO alliance's plans to expand eastwards.
